title: fix(studio): plainer authoring in Studio — option labels first, named rules, labelled fields, honest counts

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：Studio 第 24–39 行建议里能在 Studio 内直接改的 9 行落地：选项先填显示名并自动生成存储值、校验规则名随错误消息生成、条件字段按标签列出、流程节点卡显示对象标签、字段数分开计系统字段、“创建”按钮说明为何不可用、只读文本框变灰、发布提示去掉“原子”并引导去“权限”、无 Studio 权限时说明找谁开通（第 38 行，席位放宽文件面到 Console 调用点后补做）。
- 为什么改：浏览器走查发现这些地方要么说开发者术语，要么让作者卡住（例如只填了三个显示名，却提示“至少需要一个选项”）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 Studio 界面与中英文文案，不动元数据协议；已有选项改名时存储值不变，已有规则改消息时规则名不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`（选项编辑器）、`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`（规则名生成）、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（字段数与发布提示）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.optionLabelFirst-27521.test.tsx`，应 9 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Studio rows 24–39 of #27521, re-measured on `main` at `e5cce096` (code reading plus jsdom pins; no browser pass in this run). Each row is taken here with a pin, handed to the seat as a card, or answered as already done or will not do.

| Row | Bucket | What, or why not |
|---|---|---|
| 24 | Card #27833 | The New Package dialog's English help is `ManifestSchema`'s own `.describe()` by design (`package-schema.ts`, "Help text"), and the landing's overlay wording is pinned by `BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171`. A name-only first step is a dialog redesign plus a wording producer in `packages/spec`. |
| 25 | Taken | Options read Label first; a new option's value is filled in from its label until typed, so labelled options are written and the "needs at least one option" hint clears. An authored option's value never moves. The kind picker shows only on the field the record path follows (`detectStatusField`) or where an option already declares a kind. Pin: `ObjectFieldInspector.optionLabelFirst-27521`. |
| 26 | Taken | The Validations condition builder lists fields by label with the CEL spelling beside it (opt-in `labelSubjects`, so the flow mounts keep their spellings), under "Pick a field". A new rule's API name follows its message until edited; an authored name never moves. Type, severity, name and guard labels in plain words. Pins: `ConditionBuilder.subjectLabels-27521`, `ObjectValidationsPanel.ruleNameFromMessage-27521`. |
| 27 | Card #27834 (suggestion half) | Suggestion half only (defect half is #27799): a "Triggering record" target, the object pre-filled from the trigger, field pickers for keys. A feature in the Update Records node editor. |
| 28 | Taken (wording) + Card #27835 (naming) | "Atomic" is gone from the publish title, toast and confirm note (`en`, `zh`); the confirm note still says all go live or none do. Carrier check: #27356 row 17 landed in #27432 for flow nodes only. Naming other types' changes in words (a view, a validation rule by its label, keys as words) is a card. |
| 29 | Will not do | Toast placement is console-wide (`ConsoleToaster`: top-centre by objectui#13340, bottom-right refused by objectui#7482). |
| 30 | Taken (node cards) + will not do (header) | Node cards name the object by its catalog label (the host's one `useObjectCatalog` read). Pin: `FlowCanvas.objectLabel-27521`. The flow header's one-row truncation with the whole text on hover is designed (objectui#13135). The Interfaces rail row was not measured in a browser (see notes). |
| 31 | Card #27836 | "Add view" with a type choice in the Interfaces list-view inspector. |
| 32 | Taken | The object header counts the fields the canvas shows and the platform's columns apart ("2 fields (+8 system)"); "1 field" is singular there and on each form section. Pin: appended case in `DataPillar.hiddenSystemFields-11780`. |
| 33 | Taken | Add field's Create stays focusable when it cannot run, `aria-disabled`, described by the missing step. Pin: `AddFieldPopover.createReason-27521`. |
| 34 | Taken (text areas) + already done (Publish) | Disabled plain text areas in the object, field, flow-node and variable inspectors wear the primitive's disabled look. Pin: `ObjectDefaultInspector.readOnlyLook-27521`. Publish's reason on a read-only package is already there (the tooltip wrapper of objectui#12303). The number inputs read are the shared `Input` primitive, which already greys out. |
| 35 | Taken | A publish that put an app or object live says members need a permission set and offers "Open Access". Pin: appended cases in `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807`. |
| 36 | Card #27837 | Formula editor: a field picker, plain parser errors, and the error line under the footer (the footer is not overlaid in `InspectorShell`, so the overlap needs a browser read). |
| 37 | Will not do | Studio declares phones unsupported ("Studio is built for a desktop screen"); below 1024 px the pillar names ride the accessible name and tooltip by design (objectui#12725). |
| 38 | Taken | The refusal names who grants Studio access (an administrator, in Setup → Permission Sets): `en` and `zh` packs, the Console's inline `defaultValue` in `StudioRoute.tsx` (the call-site gate ties it to `en`, objectui#3810) and the route test's `NOTICE`, together. The seat widened the file surface to the Console call site for this row. Pin: `studioAccessGrantor-27521`. |
| 39 | Card #27838 | Node help is the engine's descriptor text (`useFlowNodePalette` adopts `description`), so the producer is `service-automation` / `plugin-approvals`; #27838 carries it with #27356 row 15's words half. |

## Tests

New pins: the seven files named above. Existing tests that read the old copy or behaviour were moved with it: the rule-type labels, the derived rule names, the guard group's name, the "N fields" load signal ("1 field" now), the publish toast's Access action, the confirm note's sentence and its `en` claim marker.

- Row 38 on `8170cb82`: `studioAccessGrantor-27521`, `StudioRoute.test.tsx`, `StudioRoute.accessNotice-12035`: 43/43; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Line budget**: 358 changed lines (added plus removed) of source, copy and changeset, 788 of tests, over the card's ~600 guideline on the test side. Most of the test lines are the new pins; the rows left out are listed above, not cut for size.
- **Cards filed from this pass**: #27833 (row 24), #27834 (row 27 suggestion half), #27835 (row 28 naming), #27836 (row 31), #27837 (row 36), #27838 (row 39, with #27356 row 15). Row 29 is answered will-not-do.
- **Not measured in a browser** this run: the Interfaces rail's `field_service_work_order....` row (the rail reads the target's label, else its name; a draft-only object's label may be missing there) and row 36's footer overlap.
- **Other packs**: `preview.changes.confirmNote` and `console.studio.accessRequired` changed in all ten packs; all ten carry both sentences (`check:i18n-drift`).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` still quotes the old "(one atomic release)" toast; it is outside this card's file surface and is left as is.
